title: Parameter-Free Adaptive Extragradient Methods for Generalized-Smooth Variational Inequalities
summary: Variational inequalities (VIs) provide a unified framework for optimization, saddle-point, equilibrium, and learning problems, where operators need not be globally Lipschitz. The $α$-symmetric generalized-smoothness condition allows local operator variation to grow with the operator norm, but existing extragradient methods often require unknown problem-specific constants. To address this issue, we propose PF-AEG, an explicit, line-search-free extragradient method whose stepsizes use quantities generated during the iterations, without prior knowledge of these constants.
